title: puppi3 · Traffic
description: Visitors, pageviews, top pages, sources, locations and devices (Ghost analytics)

target.rawSql:
SELECT published_at AS time, CONCAT('Published: ', title, '
This post up close ›') AS text, 'ghost' AS tags FROM posts WHERE type = 'post' AND status = 'published' AND $__timeFilter(published_at)

SELECT p."publishDate" AS time, initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) || ': ' || left(regexp_replace(p.content, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 100) || CASE WHEN i."providerIdentifier" IN ('instagram', 'instagram-standalone', 'youtube', 'bluesky', 'threads', 'tiktok', 'tiktok-business') THEN '
This post up close ›' ELSE '' END AS text, 'social,' || i."providerIdentifier" AS tags FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId" WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate")

panels.title: Visitors right now
panels.description: Last 5 minutes

panels.title: Unique visitors
panels.description: Ghost counts a visitor as unique for one day: it uses no cookies, so it can't recognise someone the next day. This adds up each day's unique visitors over the selected range, the same number Ghost Admin shows as Unique visitors, so someone who visits on 3 days counts 3 times. For a range within one day Ghost reports hours instead, so a visitor who comes back hours later counts again.

panels.title: Unique visitors per day
panels.description: Average unique visitors per day over the selected range: the total divided by the number of days, with days nobody visited counting as 0. The closest Ghost's analytics gets to "how many people". For a range shorter than a day, it's the total so far.

panels.title: Pageviews
panels.description: Pages viewed in the selected range (Ghost's web analytics).

panels.title: Pages per visitor
panels.description: Pageviews divided by unique visitors over the selected range.

panels.title: Bounce rate
panels.description: Share of visits that saw only one page, over the selected range (each day weighted by its visits).

panels.title: Avg visit length
panels.description: Average visit length over the selected range (each day weighted by its visits).

panels.title: Unique visitors & pageviews
panels.description: Daily totals (@TZ_NAME@ time). Pick a range of a few days or more; each bar is one day. Unique visitors are counted per day: Ghost can't recognise someone on a later day (no cookies). Dotted lines mark what you posted: pink = a Ghost post, violet = a social post (Postiz). Hover the triangle at the bottom of a line to see which; switch them off at the top of the dashboard.

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: Most-viewed pages in the selected range (Ghost's web analytics).

panels.title: Top sources
panels.description: Referring site of each visit (empty = direct) "Facebook" is mostly Instagram: Instagram often sends people through a Facebook address when they tap a link. "Your own site" is visits that started on @SITE_HOST@ itself (you, from Ghost Admin or previews, or someone still browsing past midnight), not a source to grow.

panels.title: Top locations
panels.description: Visitors by country (ISO code). Ghost's tracker guesses the country from the browser's time zone, never the IP. Since the page-hit-country plugin (Traefik), a time zone with no country (UTC: privacy browsers, scrapers) gets Cloudflare's country for the visitor's IP instead. Unknown = neither gave one (Tor, or visits from before the plugin).

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Visitors by device type in the selected range (Ghost's web analytics).

panels.title: Google Search (last 28 days)
panels.description: From Google Search Console, read by the bridge (search.json): clicks from Google's results to the site, times the site showed in them, the share clicked, and its average place in the results (1 = top). Google fills in a day 2-3 days late. Not affected by the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Search Console numbers: status
panels.description: When the bridge last collected them, and what went wrong if anything (no SEARCH_CONSOLE_KEY, or the service account isn't a user of the property)

panels.title: Google Search clicks & impressions per day
panels.description: Per day from Search Console (up to 16 months back, and kept by the bridge after that). The last 2-3 days aren't in yet. Follows the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: What people search for (last 28 days)
panels.description: The searches the site showed up for in Google, most clicked first (Google leaves out rare ones for privacy).

panels.title: Pages people find in Google (last 28 days)
panels.description: The site's pages in Google's results, most clicked first.

panels.title: Cloudflare (last 30 days)
panels.description: Every request Cloudflare answered for @SITE_HOST@, read by the bridge (cloudflare.json): bots, feeds and cached pages included, so far more than the visitors above (Ghost's analytics count people in browsers). Page views here minus Ghost's pageviews is roughly the bots. Not affected by the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Cloudflare numbers: status
panels.description: When the bridge last collected them, and what went wrong if anything (no CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN / CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID, or the token lacks Zone > Analytics > Read)

panels.title: Requests per day, as Cloudflare saw them
panels.description: Per day (UTC) from Cloudflare, kept by the bridge (400 days) from the day it began collecting (30 days back on its first run). Follows the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Countries (last 30 days, all requests)
panels.description: Where requests came from, bots included (Cloudflare's country for each IP). Ghost's Top locations above counts people only.
